status: Historical native 0.6.0 / v3 training diagnostics; not final v4 calibration or scientific acceptance.

provenance_policy.source_sha256: Full SHA-256 of source artifacts at companion assembly. Recorded solver/input identities are copied exactly, including their original shortened hash strings; no current build identity is substituted.
provenance_policy.omissions: Full observations, shot specs, time series and Jacobian matrices omitted. Saved observations were used only for arithmetic resolution comparisons; no simulations were run for assembly.
provenance_policy.config_scope: Selected V1 config entries retain their original definitions. Exclusive parameters/options of unused blocks are omitted; source config hashes remain available.
provenance_policy.nonfinite_serialization: Nonfinite YAML uncertainty values are represented by null, never zero.

lambda.direction: Larger lambda means slower decay, not a faster inverse rate or a time constant.

score.cups: Schmieder Eq.3 for both model and data

definitions.cost: 0.5*sum(normalized residual squared): log ratios for lambda/c0/cups plus the declared pressure residual; distinct from target counts.
definitions.optimizer: xtol success is numerical termination, not proof of stationarity or global optimality.
definitions.comparison: Trial free-parameter counts differ; these comparisons are diagnostic, not a model-selection test.

published_fraction_refit.precision: Rounded conservative bounds in the historical draft; no separate per-row refit artifact was retained.
published_fraction_refit.method: Unweighted exponential fit to published fraction concentrations at their accumulated mid-masses.

finite_difference.step_definition: Linear parameters: step times bound span. Log parameters: step in log10 coordinates.
finite_difference.difference_definition: L2norm(J_step[:,j]-J_0.0001[:,j])/max(L2norm(J_0.0001[:,j]),1e-30). Smallest step is a comparison reference, not asserted truth.

fixed.reason: Disabled by the builder for total particle loading: the initial particle concentration is not an equilibrium capacity. Kernel loading follows its source partition law and may exceed its initial value during inward diffusion. This boundary restriction is not selected by fit quality.

The initial effective connectivity deficit is a grade D model assumption (0.5), separate from coffee CO2; it is not a measured gas volume fraction. None of the calibration observables identifies a transient relative-permeability law. It is held at its prior rather than fitted to the held-out V4 first-drop delay or flow rise.
The effective connectivity-to-relative-permeability exponent is a grade D closure (3), not measured for these pucks. Held fixed; the V4 transient, V3 and V5 shot times do not select it.

The pore-air relaxation time uses (D32/2)^2/(pi^2 D), capped at 600 s, with D = 2.5e-11 m^2/s from the independent Mateus moisture-uptake range. Using moisture diffusion for air clearance is a grade D model assumption. Neither this diffusivity nor its time scale is fitted to held-out shots.
In M1.1 this is the fixed effective-loading normalization inherited from the extraction model, distinct from the full intraparticle water inventory. It is not fitted to startup observations.

Species kernel diffusivities trade off with the coffee's contents (correlation −0.89 to −0.95): their posterior SD was 2–12× the prior's, and free fits drifted 2–5× outside the literature priors (caffeine to 8×10⁻¹¹, trigonelline to the 1×10⁻⁹ bound). The species surface-pool scales carry the species' λ instead.
Not identified by V1 (see the caffeine diffusivity).
Not identified by V1 (see the caffeine diffusivity).
Weakly identified by V1 (posterior SD 1.15× the prior's; it trades off with the extractable fraction); fixing it did not raise the cost.
Not identified by V1 (posterior SD 44× the prior's once the lumped diffusivity is fixed); the surface flux is fast at any value in its range, so only the surface pool's size matters.
Not identified by V1 (posterior SD 1.6× the prior's when added at the V1 optimum); the residuals lean towards less swelling (Wald z 2.4 towards 0).
Weakly identified by V1 (posterior SD 0.4–0.7× the prior's) with no evidence against the registry value (Wald z 0.8); the CO₂ model is being re-anchored in the input models.

θ is fixed at its mechanistic default, 0 (the insoluble cell walls hold the particle envelope), not chosen by fit quality: it is collinear with the bed permeability, whose fitted values move to absorb it. `calibrate --sensitivity` reports the θ = 0.27 case as a structural sensitivity.

fixed.reason: The full intraparticle pore-water inventory behind the front (fraction 1) is held inside the total particle loading. External mobile water occupies interparticle porosity only; front filling transfers its dissolved solute into the particle reservoir conservatively. The fixed water-volume choice and instantaneous pore filling are not fitted to shot times or independent uptake data.

preparation.scope_caveat: Diagnostic global tap/base-edge overrides were not promoted. The subsequent candidate uses dataset-specific actual-spec nuisances with transformed prior supports.

pool_capacity.scope: Fixed-v3 mechanism diagnostics on V1 only; limiting cases are not proposed priors or fitted alternatives.

derived_equilibrium.assumptions: Fully wet, unsaturated, loading ceilings inactive; mathematical capacities, not measured washout times.
